style: 16:9 restrained photorealistic underwater industrial footage. Rust-orange practical lights, blue-black shadows, pale highlights. Slowly drifting silt and mild analogue grain never obscure the subjects. No captions, UI, watermark, music or narration.

elias.description: Elias is one adult male maintenance worker, approximately 1.73 m tall, with ordinary human proportions. He wears a dark charcoal rubber diving suit, worn brown canvas panels, heavy dark gloves and boots, webbing straps, and a scuffed ochre metal diving helmet with a dark glass visor. His face remains obscured; do not invent visible facial features. His suit and cuffs are intact. His shoulders are tense and his movements cautious. Keep his helmet, suit and human anatomy consistent.

harbor.description: The harbor creature is a terrifying abyssal Lovecraftian deep-sea organism of roughly human size: translucent, pressure-softened bone-pale skin over dark veins, a twisted narrow torso, disproportionately long arms ending in three long webbed fingers, ragged translucent fin rays along its spine and gill slits that slowly open and close. Grey workwear scraps are sunk into its flesh. It has no legs; its lower body tapers into a soft, fin-fringed trailing mass. Its drooping, slack, eerily calm face with small clouded eyes clashes with the distorted anatomy, never cute or friendly. It glides or pulls itself along steel with its hands; it never stands, walks or crawls. No land animal, reptile, shark or costume-monster look.

shots.storyboard: 探照灯的最后一束光已经熄灭。桥基下的苍白长肢生物没有跟随光斑离开，仍伏在门外水道旁；三根细长手指搭在钢梁边缘，少量淤泥在指尖周围散开。通往值班室的内侧通路仍从它上方经过。艾里亚斯所在的门保持关闭，画面里看不到他；本卷没有发生开门、出发或救援。

shots.sourceResult: 摄像头拍到惨白生物停在断桥下，通往内侧值班室的路经过它上方。艾里亚斯躲在遮住视线的门后。货仓门有独立配电和闸机；门未落下，不能算隔离。
shots.subject: One pale abyssal deep-sea creature clings to a broken bridge support beneath the narrow inner walkway of a flooded industrial harbor. The cargo gate is raised and its opening is unobstructed.
shots.space: A single view across the flooded docking harbor. Lower middle: the broken bridge support and the creature clinging to it. Across the upper middle: the surviving inner walkway and railing lead to a closed opaque guardroom door on the right. Left of the support: an open cargo entrance with its vertical grille raised above it; beside the entrance are a closed metal electrical cabinet and a gate control box. Keep the creature outside the cargo entrance. The closed guardroom door completely hides the survivor. Nobody is visible behind it. No image of the submarine operator or control room.
shots.camera: Stationary submarine external camera, medium-wide view angled slightly downward at the bridge support.
shots.light: Weak rust-orange emergency fixtures rake across the railing, gate tracks and pale skin. Readable grey midtones on the creature; blue-black water beyond. The closed electrical cabinet shows no internal wires or energized indicator. No moving searchlight or sonar rings.
beats: 0–3 s: establish the broken bridge support, the clinging creature, the raised cargo grille and the closed guardroom door together.
3–7 s: the creature slowly shifts one long hand against the support. Three fingers uncurl and settle; a small cloud of silt drifts down. Its head remains lowered, face slack and calm.
7–10 s: hold the same positions. The cargo opening remains open, the creature remains outside it, and the guardroom door stays shut. No lure, attack, survivor movement or gate operation occurs.
shots.audio: Subdued underwater rumble only. The survivor communication belongs to the separate radio scene; add no spoken explanation, unseen reply or caption to this recording.
shots.endState: Creature beneath the inner walkway, outside the open cargo entrance. Raised grille and closed guardroom door remain unchanged. The image cannot establish the cabinet power state or show the hidden survivor.
shots.storyboard:
潜艇停在断桥外侧，镜头略向下，整段没有移动。画面中下方，断裂的桥基伸进黑水，一只苍白、无毛的长肢人形伏在桥基上：躯干低扭，头垂在胸前，背上是一列低矮的鳍状棘；灰色工装碎片贴着身体。它缓慢松开一只手的三根细长手指，又扣回钢梁，指尖附近扬起薄薄的淤泥。
桥基上方，残存的内侧步道和栏杆通向画面右侧一扇关闭的值班室门。门板不透明，录像里看不到艾里亚斯。画面左侧是货仓入口，格栅收在入口上方；生物仍在仓外。入口旁能看见闭合的配电柜外壳和闸机控制盒，看不见柜内接线，也没有据此判断是否通电。
弱橙色应急灯照到栏杆、格栅导轨和苍白的皮肤，其余水域沉在蓝黑阴影里。结尾位置不变：生物没有离开桥基，格栅没有下降，值班室门没有打开。
